correctness.rationale: The intrinsic normal formula is the orthogonal projection of the incidence vector of each cyclic tube and gives exactly the nested/disjoint interior cosines. Compatibility of tubings identifies all ridges. Strict interval-position and gap-composition counts yield the formula including equal tube lengths and the n=3 boundary. The length-complement injection constructs more than twice as many reflected obtuse ridges for each acute parameter pair, and aggregation handles collisions. Two four-composition models converge to Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) and share the same pair-of-spacings magnitude by exchangeability. An executed standalone exact checker validates every compatible pair and squared cosine for n=3..12, Minkowski-sum face ranks for n=3..6, and reflection dominance through n=25. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite-dimensional family of cycle graph-associahedra has an exact intrinsic Euclidean angular metric invariant. The answer gives all multiplicities, a sharp global acute proportion, a previously unrecorded strict reflected-angle domination at every finite size, and a nontrivial weak limit whose conditional magnitude is symmetric but sign weights are 1:2. These results are not textbook restatements of the known face numbers or diameter, and the exact angular law can support later curvature and geometric probability calculations.
